units.title: Theory of Poetry
units.topics: (a) What is Poetry? Significant developments in the art of poetry during major literary periods. (b) Elements of Poetry: Rhythm, Meter, Sound Structure, Stanza Forms. (c) Figures of Speech and Poetic Devices: Symbols, Imagery, Simile, Metaphor, Personification, and other devices such as Repetition and Contrast. (d) Types of Poetry: Elegy, Sonnet, Dramatic Monologue, Lyric, Ode, Ballad.
